title: Zebrafish Larvae Dissociation for FACS Sorting of Fluorescent Protein-Expressing Cells
author: Abigail Elliot

steps.title: Collect Larvae
steps.instruction: Collect anaesthetised larvae in 2ml Eppendorf tubes, limiting to a maximum of 50 larvae per tube.

steps.title: Add Dissociation Solution
steps.instruction: Remove the water using a plastic pipette and replace it with 2ml of Dissociation Solution.

steps.title: Transfer to Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the larvae and the solution into the well of a 12-well plate using a plastic pipette.

steps.title: Dissociate Larvae
steps.instruction: Perform a cycle of incubation and mechanical dissociation, repeating the process 3 times (sufficient for larvae up to 4dpf) or more (may be needed for 5dpf+), until fully dissociated.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on a shaker at 200-250 rpm and 28.5 °C for 5 minutes.
Vigorously pipette up and down with a P1000 for 30 seconds per well.

steps.title: Collect Digest
steps.instruction: Transfer the digest to a pre-cooled 2ml Eppendorf tube on ice. If pooling multiple tubes, pool them into a 25ml falcon tube at this stage.

steps.title: Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected tubes at 300-500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C. Do not exceed 500g to avoid impacting cell viability.

steps.title: Resuspend and Filter
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in Media A at a ratio of 500ul per 50 larvae, then filter through a 40um filter into a FACS tube.

steps.title: FACS Sort Cells
steps.instruction: Collect live cells via FACS into Media A supplemented with 10% Goat Serum.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for 10X Loading
steps.instruction: Wash the sorted cells to reduce contaminants and ambient RNA before loading onto the 10X Chromium machine.

substeps.instruction: Perform one or preferably two wash steps (centrifuge @ 500g for 5 minutes).
Quantify cell density using a cell counter to determine the appropriate number of cells for loading (e.g., target 7,000 cells).
